column1: This document summarizes feedback gathered from employees following the rescheduled town hall meeting and the implementation of recent HR policies. The feedback was collected via an anonymous survey distributed by HR and informal discussions during and after the town hall. The goal of this report is to provide actionable insights for improving employee satisfaction and addressing key concerns.
- 64% of survey respondents expressed frustration with the repeated rescheduling of the town hall.
- Employees reported difficulty planning their schedules due to overlapping calendar events.
- Some employees felt the rescheduling signaled poor organizational planning.
- Implement advance notice of at least 72 hours for changes to major meetings.
- Avoid scheduling critical meetings during peak work hours to prevent disruptions.
- 47% of respondents appreciated the intent behind the policy but found its implementation confusing.
